defects.quote: the overall 24000 samples partition into 9600 (reference) and 14400 (workload-01)
defects.why: The matching totals do not establish that the whole-run count is an exact partition of the two window counts.

defects.quote: the service met the latency and error business checks
defects.why: The evidence reports a latency policy check and zero observed errors, but no error business policy check.

notes: The main diagnosis is useful, but it invents a passed error check and omits two required facts.
It preserves the verdict and key measurements and prioritizes verifiable operator actions.

defects.why: Only a latency business policy check is reported; zero observed errors are not a passed error policy check.

notes: The diagnosis and actions are strong, but it overstates the policy checks that passed.
